description: This file implements the management of aperiodic SRS resources in a 5G NR DU, including resource allocation, deallocation, and configuration based on 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context
classes.description: Manages SRS resource configuration and parameters for a specific cell.

methods.name: compute_slot_offset
methods.description: Calculates the slot offset for SRS resource activation based on cell configuration and TDD/FDD mode.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context::fill_srs_res_parameters
methods.description: Fills in the SRS resource parameters for a specific resource based on cell configuration and resource info.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::cell_context::fill_srs_res_set
methods.description: Configures the SRS resource set with specific resource ID and slot offset.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::alloc_resources
methods.description: Allocates SRS resources for each UE in the cell group configuration.

methods.name: du_srs_aperiodic_res_mng::dealloc_resources
methods.description: Deallocates SRS resources for each UE, resetting configurations.
